correctness_confidence.basis: Complete analytical reading found no invalidating error in the principal theorems. Endpoint parameter conversion, positivity-preserving erasure, critical moment reserve and three-block coupling were checked; the main external inequality was checked in its primary source. This is one AI reading, not independent formal verification.

rigor.basis: The proofs control actual ordered eigenvalues, strict cutoff events, exact caps, finite-prefix replacements and limiting order. A minor abstract/theorem floor mismatch should be resolved; several constants remain existential as disclosed.

novelty.basis: The exact multiplicative-cube moment/tail classifications and joint square-root transition are plausible novel syntheses relative to the primary passages checked. Hypercontractivity, sign-region bounds, code constructions and Fourier erasure have substantial prior art. Exhaustive priority and all implications of prior tail-space literature were not checked.

significance.basis: Sharp distinctions between exact marginal agreement, critical moments and transfer gaps are useful within this finite Boolean family. No application or approximate-data robustness theorem establishes broad impact; no local-dynamics, finite-range Gibbs or physical-gap consequence follows.

reproducibility.basis: Exact PDF, text, source and all-page renders are supplied; all 75 input-manifest entries matched hashes and byte lengths. All 51 pages were visually inspected through contacts and six critical native pages were inspected separately. Build reproduction, render regeneration and formal verification were not performed.

summary: This first and only numerical assessment of the exact supplied v9 PDF rates it 5.40/10 on the AIRR Millennium scale, with five public stars and minor_revision. The specialized paper provides credible sharp moment and strict-tail boundaries, a sub-square-root positive-density construction, endpoint norm rigidity and a finite-ratio lower gap bound. No invalidating defect was found, but external priority, navigation, an abstract/theorem floor mismatch and practical effectiveness remain reservations. Requested gpt-6-astra/high is not an attestation of the served backend or effort. Shared provider/filesystem and exposure to historical assessment material in the manuscript preclude a blind or independent-review claim. This is not human peer review or editorial acceptance.
strengths: Theorem 1 preserves labelled marginals of both the weighting and Perron stationary laws while producing exponentially many slow transfer modes; Proposition 5 correctly separates this from parity heat-bath dynamics.
Theorems 13 and 23 pair necessary estimates with attained constructions to establish the exact critical norm and strict-tail thresholds, including the stated endpoint floors.
Lemma 31 proves separate critical L^s and one-sided pointwise erasure bounds, preserving positivity throughout the full sub-square-root regime of Theorem 32.
Lemma 36 controls the full low/high coupling; Theorem 34 and Corollary 38 then justify positive finite-ratio gaps and quadratic small-ratio order without an illicit exchange of limits.
weaknesses: O1: External priority remains unestablished; the endpoint section should compare explicitly with named tail-space literature and its different exponents/operators.
O2: Repeated preliminary proofs and detailed historical assessments obscure the strongest final conclusions in the 51-page presentation; a theorem/dependency map and archival separation would help.
O3: The abstract omits the fixed positive floor stated in Theorem 34 and Corollary 38; align the front matter or state and justify the apparent nonnegative extension.
O4: Global constants and dimension cutoffs are existential or conservative, exact finite-C optimization remains open, and no robustness result for approximate marginal matching is supplied.
potential_errors: O3, page 1 versus pages 45 and 48: the finite-ratio abstract sentence is broader in stated hypotheses than the formal floor-constrained theorem. The proof appears extendable to nonnegative densities, so this is a scope mismatch requiring clarification, not an exhibited counterexample.
strong_novelty_candidates: The exact multiplicative Boolean critical-norm boundary 2^(1/s), including collapse at equality under every fixed floor below one, relative to the sources checked; priority unestablished.
The universal strict-tail threshold 1+s^s(1-K)K^(s-1)/(s-1)^(s-1) for (s-1)/s<K<1, with equality attained at floor K; priority unestablished.
The exact vanishing scale of the endpoint high-degree noise norm and its use in the joint marginal/moment problem; source inequalities are credited and priority is unestablished.
The positive-density sub-square-root construction, finite-ratio three-block lower bound and quadratic-order asymptotic infimum; optimal constants and exact finite-C profile remain open.
